title: Smooth trace
statement:
Work in the purity conventions [def-pur-conventions]. Thus $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth and separated of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, with smooth relative dimension as in [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the coefficient units $\Lambda_X,\Lambda_Y$, the compact-support functor $Rf_!$ of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], the constructible exceptional inverse image $Rf^!$ and adjunction $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$ of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\operatorname{Tr}_{f,K}:Rf_!Rf^!K\to K$ for its counit at $K$, and use the smooth purity map $\gamma_{f,K}:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\to Rf^!K$ of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], with the twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

The *smooth trace* is the composite
$$
\operatorname{Tr}_f^{\mathrm{sm}}:
Rf_!\bigl(\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_!(\gamma_{f,\Lambda_Y})\ }
Rf_!Rf^!\Lambda_Y
\xrightarrow{\ \operatorname{Tr}_{f,\Lambda_Y}\ }\Lambda_Y.
$$
Here the first arrow includes the canonical identification $Lf^*\Lambda_Y\cong\Lambda_X$: finite-level derived pullback is the termwise inverse image with coefficient action transported along the canonical constant-ring isomorphism, as in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map].

For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor category of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the *coefficient-valued smooth trace* is the composite
$$
\operatorname{Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}:
Rf_!\bigl(Lf^*K(d)[2d]\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_!(\gamma_{f,K})\ }
Rf_!Rf^!K
\xrightarrow{\ \operatorname{Tr}_{f,K}\ }K.
$$
Both composites are morphisms of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ whose source and target lie in the bounded constructible category $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ specified in [def-pur-conventions]: the sources because $Rf_!$ carries $D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ into $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ [prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility], applied to $\Lambda_X(d)[2d]$ and to $Lf^*K(d)[2d]\cong Rf^!K\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$; since $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ is a full subcategory, they are morphisms of $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$. The case $K=\Lambda_Y$, read through the displayed unit identification, is the first composite.

lean.statement: def smoothTrace (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] : (smoothCompactSupport P f).obj ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X P.Ring).functor.obj ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))) (2 * (d : ℤ))).obj (((smoothPurityTensor P.Coefficient X).obj ((P.smoothPurityPullback f).obj ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y P.Ring).inverse.obj (coefficientUnit P Y)))).obj ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))) (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj (P.diagonalTwist X d))))) ⟶ coefficientUnit P Y
